description: Edit an agent's live runtime configuration — greeting/first message, inbound or SMS prompt, the after-call summary and lead-score instructions, voice, language model, max call duration, and call-transfer settings — routed through the governed update broker so every change keeps the consent + audit trail (a versioned config snapshot and change history). Read get_agent_config first; inbound_prompt replaces the whole prompt. Each applied change is saved as a version (list_config_versions); rollback_config can restore a version's greeting, voice, prompt, model and summary/scoring, but not transfer settings or call length. Mutating changes need an idempotency_key. When the business owner or an admin is signed in through this connector, their own changes apply immediately. High-impact live changes made with an API key or on someone else's behalf queue for the owner's review instead (the owner is notified with a review link). configure_agent_business_rules edits a single named operational-rules section.

actor.description: Do not set. Kept for older clients; the signed-in connection identifies you.

authority.description: Do not set. It cannot approve a change: the owner approves through review_url or by being signed in.

business_id.description: Business ID. Required when the agent has multiple accessible assignments.

call_summary_instructions.description: How the summary written after each call should read, in plain language (for example "Write exactly two sentences for the attorney..."). Changes only the summary; the prompt and scoring stay as they are. get_operational_settings shows the current text.

dry_run.description: Validate and summarize the change without writing.

first_message.description: Spoken greeting / first message callers hear.

idempotency_key.description: Required for writes. Reuse the same key when retrying the same change.

inbound_prompt.description: The whole inbound prompt; it replaces the current one. Start from inbound_prompt in get_agent_config, never from a saved version.

lead_score_instructions.description: How each caller is scored from 0 to 100, in plain language. Changes only the scoring. End it with "Respond with ONLY a number from 0 to 100."

model.description: Language model selection: { provider, model, temperature }.

queue_for_approval.description: When authority is missing, create a pending dashboard approval instead of returning needs_approval.

reason.description: Why this change is being made. Kept in the change history.

source_ref.description: External source reference, such as a support ticket or conversation ID.

transfer_phone_number.description: Number to transfer qualified calls to.

voice.description: Voice selection: { provider, voiceId }. Use voice_catalog_id instead when you can.

voice_catalog_id.description: Preferred way to pick a voice: an id from list_voices.
